name: telegram_approval_delivery_20261022
comment: Telegram approvals reach the ledger or say why not (2026-10-22; operator decision: sensitive Command Center
actions are confirmed by a Telegram Approve tap). A grant that fails after settle re-opens the request
(PENDING) instead of spending it; the tap outcome is returned and logged by the poller; `bin/guard request`
records the provider message id on the request row; telegram_reply_processor (recovery-watch 07:30) no
longer polls getUpdates unless TELEGRAM_REPLY_PROCESSOR_POLL=1 (the 07:30 HTTP 409s).
